notes.title: Game Balancing and Various Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello, fellow survivors!

I've heard your feedback and have implemented some exciting changes to enhance your gaming experience:


 Increased Experience Gain: You will now earn more experience points, especially during the first few levels, to help you progress faster.
 Larger Pickup Area: The area in which you can collect experience has been expanded, making it easier to gather.
 Bug Fixes: We've fixed a game-breaking bug related to the drone upgrade to ensure smoother gameplay.
 Balanced Enemy Spawning: Enemy spawning patterns have been adjusted for better balance, providing a more challenging yet fair experience.

That's it for now. Keep playing and let the fight for survival begin!
